description: AdvenBook turns your outdoor adventures into a premium printed book. Tell ChatGPT about your hikes, trail runs, bike rides or treks — routes, dates, distances, photos and stories — and AdvenBook lays them out automatically: GPS maps of each route, elevation profiles, stats, your photos and your words. You get a price right away and a private link to preview and edit your book, then order it on advenbook.com. Hardcover, softcover or spiral notebook, printed near you and shipped for free.
